svg.title: CaféMesh AI — 09-end-to-end-capabilities
svg.text: The complete visit, café operation and improvement loop; current coverage is explicitly limited.
MIXED = demo path plus substantial missing work. PLANNED = no complete implemented workflow. Full criteria: docs/14-END-TO-END-CAPABILITIES.md
Reviewed menu / safety / price / hours / spaces.
Today: code fixtures; no administration workflow.
Customer: participating café, intent and route.
Amenities, demand, halfway and group planning.
Today: Places / Routes; synthetic café context.
Today: lexical rules / feedback; safety gaps.
Customer: current quote and explicit consent.
Reserve stock / capacity; payment when enabled.
Today: synthetic preview and order only.
Missing TTL, transactions and retry binding.
Team: station, queue, inventory and arrival.
Today: synthetic lifecycle and timing samples.
Team: owned recovery and shift handover.
Customer: correct preferences and control data.
Opt-in loyalty; inspect / export / delete profile.
Today: four bounded weights; shared demo user.
Today: decision audit and limited demo metrics.
Human review of facts, cases and interventions.
Today: review signals; no automatic promotion.
Approved improvements return to governed facts
PLANNED · CONNECTS TO PLANNING AND EXPERIENCE
Events / moderated interest tables → consented joins → group visits.
Meet-halfway planning; leave / hide / block / report controls.
Direct person matching only after identity, consent and moderation.
RELEASE GATE · NOT IMPLEMENTED AS A COMPLETE PLATFORM
Tenant roles · governed records · transactional stock / orders.
Privacy lifecycle · approved adapters · accessibility / localization.
Backups / recovery · support ownership · monitoring and budgets.
Structured facts remain authoritative; model output cannot authorize safety or a real-world action.
Versioned agent tools, prompts and evaluations; governed RAG / voice only after specific acceptance gates.
Reliable events and metric definitions; SLOs, privacy, cost limits, human releases, canary and rollback.
Maps listing ≠ participating café. Demo confirmation ≠ fulfillment. Manager acceptance ≠ execution.
Delivery slices: close demo gaps → controlled café pilot → complete visit / recovery → community & multi-location → evaluated optimization.
